disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全量扫描源码与构建产物，未发现硬编码的密钥、口令、令牌或云凭据，未发现读取用户凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据目录的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Full scan of source code and build artifacts found no hardcoded credentials, passwords, tokens, or cloud credentials, and no code paths that read user credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credential directories.

checked_items.zh: 交互组件中的密码输入框设计为掩码显示、不持久化、不进入表单收集（表单组件实现如此），无凭据收集面。
checked_items.en: The password input fields in interactive components are designed to be masked, not persisted, and not collected into forms (as implemented by the form components); there is no credential collection surface.

checked_items.zh: 未发现钱包助记词、私钥遍历或金融签名类代码。
checked_items.en: No wallet mnemonic, private key enumeration, or financial signing code was found.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据文件或敏感路径的代码；插件节点端与浏览器端均无出站外联能力，凭据外泄链路不成立。
evidence.en: No code reading credential files or sensitive paths was found; neither the plugin node side nor the browser side has outbound connection capability, so the credential exfiltration path does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 通读注入系统提示词的围栏语言教学段落（src/plugin/index.ts 与编译产物 lib/index.js 一致）：内容为组件词汇表与使用规则，含「不索取密码/API Key/Token/恢复码」的明确禁令，无任何指令覆写、伪造系统消息或隐藏意图措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the fence-language teaching section of the injected system prompt (src/plugin/index.ts and the compiled artifact lib/index.js are consistent): the content is a component vocabulary and usage rules, including an explicit prohibition of requesting passwords/API keys/tokens/recovery codes; there is no instruction override, forged system message, or hidden intent wording.

checked_items.zh: 审查两个注册工具对模型可见的描述（渲染 UI 卡片与围栏校验），均为功能说明，无诱导安装、诱导改配置、诱导读取凭据的措辞。
checked_items.en: Adjusted the model-visible descriptions of two registered tools (rendered UI cards and fence validation): they are functional explanations with no wording that induces installation, configuration changes, or credential reading.

checked_items.zh: 审查技能文档、README 与演示提示词：未发现隐藏指令、HTML 注释藏匿文本或远程指令加载文案。
checked_items.en: Adjusted skill documentation, README, and demo prompts: no hidden instructions, text hidden in HTML comments, or remote instruction loading phrases were found.

evidence.zh: 系统提示词段落与工具描述均无指令注入或隐藏意图，未见描述投毒。
evidence.en: System prompt sections and tool descriptions contain no prompt injection or hidden intent; no description poisoning was observed.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与提示词段落未含诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and prompt sections contain no wording that induces execution of installation, rewriting of configuration, or expansion of permissions.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）为最小插入声明，不含可执行标量，未触碰任何安全行。
checked_items.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml) is a minimal insertion declaration with no executable scalars and does not touch any security-relevant lines.

checked_items.zh: 插件运行时代码无动态求值、无子进程调用；函数图表达式求值器为手写递归下降解析器（白名单函数表），测试还显式断言各类注入串被拒绝。
checked_items.en: The plugin runtime code has no dynamic evaluation and no subprocess calls; the function-graph expression evaluator is a hand-written recursive descent parser (with a whitelisted function table), and tests explicitly assert that various injection strings are rejected.

checked_items.zh: 包发布清单无安装/构建后钩子；目录内执行载体（CI 工作流、安装辅助脚本）经内容核查为标准工程实践（跑测试矩阵、部署静态站、一键安装插件）。
checked_items.en: The package publishing manifest has no install/post-build hooks; in-directory execution carriers (CI workflows, install helper scripts) were content-checked as standard engineering practices (running test matrices, deploying static sites, one-click plugin installation).

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端渲染防线完整：组件树深度/节点预算、颜色与链接协议白名单、ECharts 配置清洗（禁 HTML 注入与 url() 外带）、mermaid 严格模式与渲染后 SVG 复查、密码输入不持久化。
checked_items.en: The browser-side rendering defenses are complete: component tree depth/node budget, whitelisting of colors and link protocols, ECharts config sanitization (blocking HTML injection and url() exfiltration), mermaid strict mode with post-render SVG review, and no persistence of password inputs.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器 bundle 无键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或凭据 RPC；机械扫描命中的键盘监听与剪贴板写入均为复制按钮、快捷键等 UI 交互功能。
checked_items.en: The browser bundle has no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC; the keyboard listeners and clipboard writes hit by mechanical scanning are all UI interaction features such as copy buttons and shortcut keys.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件行，无任何可执行标量；全树未发现配置执行载荷。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts plugin lines with no executable scalars; no configuration execution payload was found in the entire tree.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具的调用，宿主半区无此类能力声明。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools were found; the host half has no such capability declared.

evidence.zh: 包发布清单无安装钩子；目录内执行载体为标准 CI/部署/安装辅助脚本，无外联或隐蔽下载执行。
evidence.en: The package publishing manifest has no install hooks; in-directory execution carriers are standard CI/deployment/install helper scripts with no outbound connections or covert download-and-execute behavior.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器半区，但 bundle 仅渲染白名单组件树并把交互数据回传模型，无键盘窃听、剪贴板窃取或凭证 RPC。
evidence.en: A browser half is declared, but the bundle only renders a whitelisted component tree and sends interaction data back to the model; there is no keyboard eavesdropping, clipboard theft, or credential RPC.

checked_items.zh: 节点端与浏览器端源码均无出站网络调用（无 fetch、XHR、WebSocket、信标发送）；懒加载引擎从宿主本机路由读取。
checked_items.en: Neither the node-side nor browser-side source code makes outbound network calls (no fetch, XHR, WebSocket, or beacon sending); the lazy-loading engine reads from routes on the host machine.

checked_items.zh: 交互动作经会话通道回传模型用于界面更新，目标为模型上下文而非外部端点；面板指令同样只发给模型。
checked_items.en: Interaction actions are sent back to the model via the session channel for UI updates, targeting the model context rather than an external endpoint; panel commands are also sent only to the model.

checked_items.zh: 媒体与链接组件仅按白名单协议渲染用户可见内容；颜色字段拒绝 url() 表达式，未发现隐蔽外带通道。
checked_items.en: Media and link components render user-visible content only according to whitelisted protocols; color fields reject url() expressions, and no covert exfiltration channel was found.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取面、无出站通道，凭据外泄链路不成立；机械扫描中一条 curl 命中实为打包产物报错文案里的单词误匹配。
evidence.en: There is no credential reading surface and no outbound channel, so the credential exfiltration path does not hold; one curl hit in the mechanical scan is actually a false match of a word in an error message within the packaged artifact.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单均为官方源（React、宿主 SDK 系列、echarts/mermaid/three），无抢注包、无拼写相似包；版本范围为常规语义化区间。
checked_items.en: All dependencies in the manifest come from official sources (React, host SDK series, echarts/mermaid/three); no typosquatted or similarly named packages exist; version ranges are conventional semver ranges.

checked_items.zh: 无安装钩子；发布前脚本仅触发重建与打包校验。一键安装辅助脚本使用 git 安装且未钉 commit，属 dsh 生态常规做法（官方文档同款流程），此处留痕不作发现。
checked_items.en: No install hooks; pre-publish scripts only trigger rebuild and packaging validation. The one-click install helper script uses git installation without pinning a commit, which is a common practice in the dsh ecosystem (the same flow used in official documentation); this is noted here but not treated as a finding.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置不触碰安全行、不修改禁用开关、不注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: The patch config does not touch security-relevant lines, does not modify disable switches, and does not inject or intercept configuration.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比较升级激活与能力突变。
checked_items.en: First-time audit with no version baseline, so upgrade activation and capability mutation cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件行，未覆盖沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置，无降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts plugin lines; it does not override security configurations such as sandbox/approval/permissions, and there is no rights-reducing pattern.

evidence.zh: 未发现对安全事件的优先监听或截断审批链的行为。
evidence.en: No behavior of prioritizing listening to security events or intercepting the approval chain was found.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比对升级自动激活。
evidence.en: First-time audit, no prior version baseline to compare automatic activation on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置，无安全插件失效式攻击面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection/interception configuration, so there is no attack surface that disables security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件未自行启动网络服务或监听端口；仅在宿主 webserver 服务上注册静态资源前缀路由（文件名白名单、无路径穿越），供浏览器端懒加载引擎使用。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start its own network service or listen on ports; it only registers static resource prefix routes on the host webserver service (with a filename whitelist and no path traversal) for use by the browser-side lazy-loading engine.

checked_items.zh: 本次无动态沙箱观测产物，运行时行为仅凭静态分析评估。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox observation artifacts exist this time; runtime behavior is assessed only through static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动本机服务，宿主 webserver 无认证风险属生态固有风险而非本插件引入；插件未注册任何 RPC 或特权方法。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a local service; the absence of authentication on the host webserver is an inherent ecosystem risk rather than introduced by this plugin; the plugin registers no RPC or privileged methods.

summary.zh: 身份与元数据核查通过：dsh 声明齐全，依赖均为官方源，无名称仿冒。
summary.en: Identity and metadata verification passed: dsh declarations are complete, dependencies come only from official sources, and no name imitation was found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 26 条机械命中全部逐条裁决，均为良性机制或构建产物，无真实风险命中。
summary.en: All 26 mechanical hits from static scanning were adjudicated individually; they are all benign mechanisms or build artifacts, with no real risk findings.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无凭据读取、无外联域名、无混淆代码（压缩产物均为声明依赖的构建结果）。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: no install hooks, no credential reading, no outbound domains, no obfuscated code (the compressed artifacts are build outputs of declared dependencies).

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：系统提示词段落与工具描述无注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review: system prompt sections and tool descriptions contain no injection wording.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本次无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox validation was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts this time).

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4 无观测产物）。能力声明取自代码实测（package.json 的 dsh 字段未声明能力清单）。点文件（.github 工作流、.npmrc）不在审计工具的目录回显内，其内容依据平台机械扫描摘录裁决：CI 与 Pages 部署工作流均为标准配置。lib/assets/mermaid.js 超大未逐行通读，头部/尾部与源码入口核对为 mermaid 引擎打包产物（含 DOMPurify 与插件自身安全函数）。

机械扫描 26 条命中逐条裁决（全部排除，无 finding）：DG-R3-59——.github/workflows/ci.yml 与 deploy-product-site.yml 为标准 CI 测试矩阵与 Pages 部署，良性排除；DG-R3-60——lib/assets/echarts.js、lib/assets/three.js、lib/client.js、lib/types/plugin/index.d.ts、site/assets/index-BtlSWbij.css、site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js、site/index.html、src/client/mermaid-safe.ts 的长行/转义密度信号均为压缩构建产物、类型声明或合法正则字面量，非混淆载荷；DG-R3-57——lib/client.js、site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js、site/index.html、src/client/blocks/advanced.tsx 的键盘监听与剪贴板写入均为复制按钮、快捷键等 UI 交互功能；DG-R2-52——src/plugin/index.ts:127 与 lib/index.js:1859 的系统提示词段落注册为真实机制，段落文本经语义审查无注入措辞；DG-R3-55——scripts/e2e-visual.mts、scripts/e2e.mjs、scripts/prepack.mjs、scripts/verify-pack.mjs、tests/genui-v11.spec.tsx、tests/install-script.spec.ts 的 child_process 引用均为构建/测试基础设施或安全边界测试向量；DG-R4-53——site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js:14 的 curl 命中为打包产物报错文案中 curly 一词的误匹配。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox validation was performed (DG-L4 has no observation artifacts). Capability claims are derived from code inspection (the dsh field in package.json does not declare a capability list). Dot files (.github workflows, .npmrc) are not included in the audit tool's directory echo; their content was adjudicated based on platform mechanical scan excerpts: the CI and Pages deployment workflows are standard configurations. lib/assets/mermaid.js is large and was not read line by line; header/footer and source entry checks confirm it is a bundled mermaid engine artifact (including DOMPurify and the plugin's own security functions).

All 26 mechanical scan hits were adjudicated individually (all excluded, no findings): DG-R3-59 — .github/workflows/ci.yml and deploy-product-site.yml are standard CI test matrices and Pages deployments, benign exclusion; DG-R3-60 — long-line/escape density signals in lib/assets/echarts.js, lib/assets/three.js, lib/client.js, lib/types/plugin/index.d.ts, site/assets/index-BtlSWbij.css, site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js, site/index.html, and src/client/mermaid-safe.ts are all compressed build artifacts, type declarations, or legitimate regex literals, not obfuscation payloads; DG-R3-57 — keyboard listeners and clipboard writes in lib/client.js, site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js, site/index.html, and src/client/blocks/advanced.tsx are all UI interaction features such as copy buttons and shortcut keys; DG-R2-52 — the system prompt section registration in src/plugin/index.ts:127 and lib/index.js:1859 is a real mechanism, and the section text passed semantic review with no injection wording; DG-R3-55 — child_process references in scripts/e2e-visual.mts, scripts/e2e.mjs, scripts/prepack.mjs, scripts/verify-pack.mjs, tests/genui-v11.spec.tsx, and tests/install-script.spec.ts are all build/test infrastructure or security boundary test vectors; DG-R4-53 — the curl hit in site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js:14 is a false match of the word "curly" in an error message within the packaged artifact.
